title: VendPoint Field Service Note: Units a Failed Vend Did Not Dispense, by Machine Type
content:
Field service note for the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program on the vend error credit Corbett owes for the failed latest vend of a retired item whose stock has run out.

How the machine dispenses can replace the units of the latest vend in the standard credit value with the units the failed vend did not dispense: on a carousel or a locker machine, where the vend opens a bay or door and the employee takes what it holds, the shortfall replaces them; on a smart crib, where the scale counts every unit, the shortfall less the model's shrink tolerance percentage of the retired item's units loaded, never below zero, replaces them; on any other machine, which issues a vend whole or not at all, the units of the latest vend stand.

**Terms.** The machine type is the dispensing technology of the machine's model (locker, coil, carousel or smart crib). The shortfall is the amount by which the retired item's stock ledger stands below zero. The retired item's units loaded are all of its units loaded on restock visits on the machine. The shrink tolerance percentage is the model's figure.

| Machine type | Units the failed vend did not dispense |
|---|---|
| Carousel | The shortfall |
| Locker | The shortfall |
| Smart crib | The shortfall less the shrink tolerance percentage of the units loaded, never below zero |
| Coil (any other machine) | The units of the latest vend |

### Hypothetical cases

Shortfall 3 units, latest vend 4 units:

- Locker or carousel: 3 units.
- Smart crib with a 1.5% tolerance and 100 units loaded: 1.5% of 100 is 1.5; 3 less 1.5 is 1.5 units. With 200 units loaded: 3 less 3 is 0 units.
- Coil: 4 units, the units of the latest vend.
